narrative.overview: Preserve the implemented theme, not a replacement identity. Compact typography, tonal cards and violet actions organize subscription management and administration. The app supplies its own palette rather than mirroring Telegram's client theme; Telegram supplies viewport safe areas.
keyCharacteristics: Dark violet surfaces with light text and restrained borders.
Persistent shell navigation around one scrolling content region.
Bounded pages, independent collection controls and Russian/English labels.

rules.name: The Bounded Page Rule
rules.body: Long collections throughout the Mini App replace the visible page rather than append rows with “Load more.” Default page size is 5; choices are 5, 10 and 20. Keep Previous, current page and Next explicit.

rules.name: The Honest Total Rule
rules.body: Cursor-backed collections show the current page without a fabricated last page or total. Local snapshot pagination may show page totals only for the returned bounded dataset; recent logs and reconnect history are not complete archives.

dos: Do preserve the incumbent dark violet palette, system typography, shell and RU/EN behavior.
Do use bounded pages with explicit backward/forward navigation for long collections.
Do reset pagination after filters or page-size changes and keep each collection independent.
Do retain visible focus, labeled state and narrow-screen wrapping.
donts: Don't invent cursor totals or describe bounded recent logs as a complete archive.
Don't turn the pager into a fixed overlay or accumulate pages with “Load more.”
Don't introduce a replacement brand, font family or decorative asset system in a structural refinement.
Don't ship synthetic review screenshots from `.impeccable/review` as product assets; this improvement adds no shipping raster assets.
